# Hardware list for a 1-inch body lift

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

[Partial] Install two 10mm-1.25 x 55 bolts and add two 10mm-1.25 x 140 bolts for a bumper lift of 2 inches. [t1483]

[Partial] Secure the frame with two 12mm-1.25 x 140 bolts using a 10.9 hex head. [t1483]

Fit six 7/16-14 x 5 bolts with Grade 8 hex heads. [t1483]

Thread six Grade C lock nuts sized at 7/16-14. [t1483]
